__*Let's get started!*__

1. Download the b.Board cover for the __Firewalls__ activity: **EN**: [👉 Click here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iqAhenUqRMt-lD1YFZ4KcsKP85RTlDrv/view?usp=sharing), **FR**: [👉 Cliquez ici](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_pSc9wKexFAGv_ucgy_RlgKcaYAghxD7/view?usp=sharing).  

![Firewalls](https://github.com/Brilliant-Labs/code.bl/blob/code_alpha/packaged/docs/static/mb/projects/bboa    rd-tutorials-cyberville-full/Firewalls/Firewall.png?raw=true "Firewalls")

2. Download the ``Code Example`` .hex file for this activity by clicking [⬇️ Here](https://www.brilliantlabs.ca/documents/cybersec/Cyber-Security-Activity-9A.hex). 
Once downloaded, you can either drag and drop it into a new project or click the **📝 Edit** icon in the programming view below to open and customize it using the 🧩 Blocks editor.

3. Based on the Cybersecurity skills you’ve developed in class, load your customized code onto the b.Board and complete the full activity.

4. (Optional) Download the printable card game in **English**: [👉 Click here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GMpfjcZno42_7VkLdOA70ZZM_1zCveUm/view?usp=sharing).


### ~ avatar
- Please do not forget to set up the correct name and password for the access point. 
- Mute the PC sound to listen the __b.Board__ sound.

3. Click on it.
